jamie (product): Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the SDK RFC about retries/backoff + streaming ergonomics. Customers keep asking for deterministic hedging and clear deadline propagation. Can we list launch criteria?

sasha (devex): Short list proposal: 1) ergonomic surface (one obvious config for common cases), 2) deterministic behavior for hedging + streaming, 3) telemetry + hooks for failures/attempts.

kevin (eng-runtime): Runtime constraints to call out: hedging + streaming can cause duplicate token emission if KV cache isn't quiesced across attempts. Acceptance test: no duplicate token outputs when hedging is enabled.

maria (eng-platform): Suggested phased rollout: Phase A - basic per-attempt timeouts + simple max_attempts; Phase B - hedging + streaming backpressure; Phase C - auto-tuning/telemetry recommendations. Phase A should be lowest risk for Dedicated + Private.

aaron (eng-infra): FYI Dedicated pools with pinned GPUs + KV cache optimization can't support cross-attempt cache invalidation today. Need a feature flag so customers don't get silent behavior changes.

lili (customer-success): From enterprise customers: they want either consistent P95 (no hedging) or an explicit opt-in hedging flag with docs on latency variability. Also need an acceptance test that shows 95th latency distribution before/after.

jamie (product): Good. Let's capture concrete acceptance criteria. Draft below — please comment.

sasha (devex): Acceptance criteria draft (please copy/edit):
- Users can configure `max_attempts`, `per_attempt_timeout_ms`, and a single `hedging` toggle in the SDK with sane defaults.
- When `hedging.enabled = true`, SDK must not duplicate output tokens across parallel attempts.
- Deadline propagation: top-level request timeout is communicated to underlying attempts; no attempt runs beyond request deadline.
- Streaming ergonomics: `backpressure` default = `auto`, `prefetch` default = 1; SDK must expose hooks for partial responses and a final completion event.
- Telemetry: emit attempt_count, last_attempt_error, hedging_fraction, and p95_latency per-route.

sasha (devex): Example config snippet for RFC (for discussion):
```json
{
  "request_timeout_ms": 120000,
  "per_attempt_timeout_ms": 30000,
  "max_attempts": 3,
  "hedging": { "enabled": true, "delay_ms": 50 },
  "streaming": { "backpressure": "auto", "prefetch": 1 }
}
```

kevin (eng-runtime): Edgecases to add to RFC: streaming + hedging + function-calling — ensure only one function call emitted, others are suppressed. Also test with short-sequence models (few tokens) where hedging overhead dominates.

maria (eng-platform): Metrics/launch gating: we need 1) unit tests for no-duplication, 2) e2e test against Dedicated with feature flag, 3) telemetry dashboard showing attempt distribution.

aaron (eng-infra): Ops note: add server-side safeguard: if a request is hedged and both attempts hit the same GPU, avoid double-writing to logs/audit sinks. That was a gotcha in past rollouts.

lili (customer-success): Suggest we add a short migration doc for customers moving from old SDK to new default behavior (hedging off by default).

ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/pull/789 (initial RFC draft) :eyes:

jamie (product): Thanks all — actionable next steps: sasha to draft PRD + RFC with the acceptance criteria above, kevin to add runtime tests for duplication and function-calling edgecases, maria to outline rollout plan + dashboards, aaron to add infra feature-flag plan, lili to draft customer migration note. We'll reconvene in 48 hours. :thumbsup:
